_comment: Single source for which component may read which secret. Terraform applies it (secrets.tf); tests/credential_audit/test_gcp_iam.py enforces it (TM-05). Values are never in Terraform: add versions with `gcloud secrets versions add`.

supabase-oauth-client-secret.purpose: Supabase OAuth app client secret, for the code exchange and token refresh (Phase 3).

github-app-private-key.purpose: GitHub App private key. Only the Tier 1 Fix Drafter's own service account will read it (Phase 5).

token-encryption-key.purpose: Envelope key for user OAuth tokens at rest (TM-05). Only postern-api, the token broker, reads it (ADR-012).

llm-api-key.purpose: Unused: Gemini on Vertex AI authenticates as the worker's own service account, so no LLM key exists (ADR-012).

control-plane-db-url-api.purpose: Connection string for postern-api's own Postgres role on Postern's control plane (Phase 2).

control-plane-db-url-worker.purpose: Connection string for postern-worker's own Postgres role on Postern's control plane (Phase 2).

resend-api-key.purpose: Email provider key. Only the notification service's own service account will read it (Phase 6).
